issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DataElement DSTU1 ballot issue asking whether DataElement.category intentionally had no assigned value set and resolving to add an example binding to the same usage-context codes as the value set.
initial_application: No current commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5458 was found. Historical source shows the relevant DataElement.category concept was overtaken by FHIR-5376: commit 91a79d84 changed DataElement.category/search category to DataElement.useContext/context with a UseContext binding, and commit 8ec1d99 changed that binding to ConformanceUseContext with supported-context wording.
additional_context: DataElement is no longer an active current-build resource. Current source/fhir.ini comments out the DataElement resource, work group, TLA, and mapping entries; current source has no source/dataelement tree or DataElement.category definition; and commit 29576ed0ef intentionally removed DataElement from the build in 2017. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were changed because there is no active current-spec DataElement.category source location to edit.
